entrypoints.summary: A requester visits a ServeDir directory listing served with DirectoryServeMode::HtmlFileList.
An attacker who can create or influence a file or directory name within the served directory supplies a name rendered by the listing.

affected_components.role: The advisory identifies this component as constructing the vulnerable listing with raw dynamic values.
The inspected patch excerpt shows HTML listing payloads returned through the HTML response path behind the html feature.

observability.channel: browser rendering of HTTP directory-listing response
negative_controls: The same metacharacters appear as escaped text rather than parsed HTML.
No injected image element or event-handler markup is created.
observability.positive_marker: The advisory describes the browser interpreting injected HTML and executing its benign JavaScript payload.

preconditions: The attacker can create or influence at least one file or directory name in a served path.
A victim visits the generated directory listing in a browser.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: A filename beginning with a double quote and greater-than sign, followed by an img element with src=x and an onerror handler.
trigger_steps.summary: Create a served-directory file whose name contains a quote-breaking HTML image tag with an onerror handler.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: HTTP request for the configured directory-listing path.
trigger_steps.summary: Serve that directory via ServeDir in HtmlFileList mode and request the listing in a browser.

capabilities.concept: inject markup into ServeDir HTML directory listing
execute script in a visiting user's browser under the served application origin

impacts.concept: cross-site scripting in a directory-listing page
compromise of browser-side same-origin session or UI integrity

mitigations.concept: context-aware escaping of dynamic directory-listing HTML values

sources.concept: attacker-influenced served-directory filename or URI path component

impact.affected_asset: The integrity of HTML served from the application origin and browser sessions or same-origin actions accessible to a victim page.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause browser-side interpretation of attacker-influenced markup or JavaScript when a user visits an affected listing, subject to the ability to influence a served path/name and to HtmlFileList being enabled.
impact.security_effect: Stored or reflected cross-site scripting in the generated ServeDir directory-listing page.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker-controlled file or directory name in the served directory, or URI path component, reaches the HTML-directory-listing renderer when HtmlFileList mode is enabled.
Values that can contain HTML metacharacters are embedded into HTML text and attribute contexts without HTML or attribute-safe escaping.
String formatting constructs table links, breadcrumb links, title, and heading with raw entry-name and URI-path values, including entry.name in both href and link-text positions.
A browser viewing the resulting directory listing can interpret injected markup or JavaScript in the application origin.

failure.operation: HTML directory-listing construction via format strings with raw entry-name and URI-path values

primary_invariant.statement: Every file name, directory name, URI-path part, and derived path value must be encoded for its precise HTML text or attribute context before it is incorporated into the generated directory-listing document.
primary_invariant.violated_because: The reported renderer interpolates entry names and path-derived values directly into HTML format strings, including a quoted href attribute and element content.

quality.review_notes: The OSV record and project advisory give a concrete configuration and proof-of-concept procedure, but the bundle contains no independent execution transcript. The inspected patch confirms an upstream fix commit and HTML-feature gating/rendering change, but the available patch excerpt does not expose all escaping implementation details or a test-run result. Claims remain advisory- and patch-grounded, not independently reproduced.

remediation.invariant_restored: Directory-listing dynamic values must be rendered through context-appropriate escaping rather than interpolated as raw HTML; the fix commit is titled as escaping XSS in HtmlFileList and moves rendering through rama_http::html.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: Current main branch before patched commit 89ddff578fd78bbebec99482d7030f28c07757a3

oracle.channel: HTTP response inspected by a browser or response parser
oracle.expected_negative: After remediation, the listing represents metacharacters in the filename and path as escaped text and does not create injected elements or executable event-handler markup.
oracle.expected_positive: Before remediation, a listing containing an attacker-influenced metacharacter-bearing filename is rendered as markup such that the advisory's benign image onerror payload is interpreted by the browser.
